returned.text: {"question_target":"T03","reply":"A good place to start is with the two big decisions tied to your goals: keeping your cardiologist and understanding visit costs. Medicare has two main paths: Original Medicare, which is Parts A and B through the federal program, or Medicare Advantage, which is a private plan that provides Parts A and B. With Original Medicare, you may add a separate drug plan and possibly Medigap; with Medicare Advantage, most plans include drug coverage. In either path, the Part B premium still applies. For costs, look at both the monthly premium and what you pay when you use care, like deductibles, copays, or coinsurance.
